title: rpl_routing vector initial_multi_parent_grouped_install committed failing (root rejects grouped multi-target DAO)
description: Found running bead y7wh's twister validation on the AWS v3.7.0 builder. test_canonical_route_state_vectors fails on native_sim/native/64 at BOTH HEAD (6212034cbf+beads) and the pinned 65ca175106: 'Assertion failed at lichen/tests/rpl_routing/src/main.c:1233: (accepted not equal to vector->accepted): initial_multi_parent_grouped_install: acceptance (installed): got 0 expected 1'. So the vector was committed failing at the pin commit; not a later regression. Vector: rpl_route_state_vectors.h:408, a 110-byte DAO (dao_len=110) with grouped multi-target RPL Target+Transit-Information options (path_control 0x80 on first, 0x40/0x10 on later targets, path_lifetime 255), expecting accepted=true reason=installed with 5 targets. Hypothesis to check: process_dao/_ex rejects the grouped frame (option framing/overlap check in rpl_dao_process.c per bead 25l3's 'exact DAO option framing' work, or target-count/capacity interplay) OR the fixture generator (generate_rpl_route_state_fixture.py) emitted an inconsistent DAO for a grouped install. Verify against spec DAO framing (spec/07 RPL chapter / draft-lora-rpl) before touching either side; do not weaken the vector without a spec argument. Twister artifacts: /mnt/lichen-zephyr/work/twister-daoauth-y7wh (HEAD) and twister-daoauth-65ca (pin) on the builder EBS. The other 19 cases incl. all four DAO-auth matrix cases named in y7wh PASS.
close_reason: Fixed via spec 8.7.2 delegations rather than weakening the vectors. Root cause: the 4 grouped vectors (initial_multi_parent_grouped_install, equal_exact_semantic_replay_no_refresh, equal_reordered_equivalence_no_refresh, grouped_equal_target_is_reserved_during_reclamation) have origins advertising foreign /128 targets (:11->:12 x3, :15->:13 x1); the origin-authorization hardening (65ca175106, spec/05-routing.md 8.6/8.7.1) correctly rejects them, but the oracle predated that hardening. A foreign-target purge cascaded: :12 threads through ~40 later expected states. Instead the oracle now carries a top-level delegations array (:12 delegated to :11, :13 to :15) per spec 8.7.2 (implemented in C AND Rust for /128 today); the C fixture generator emits a delegations table and the harness registers them via lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate() before the vector loop, with lichen_rpl_prefix_delegations_reset() in the before() fixture for per-test isolation. Generator always emits the table (zero-length array OK under Zephyr GCC) so no preprocessor arithmetic. 3x review findings fixed: build_document() now emits delegations (test/vectors/generate_rpl_route_state.py) so the JSON determinism gate --check passes and regeneration cannot drop the key; schema.json rpl_route_state_document accepts the typed delegations property; before() reset added. Validation on AWS v3.7.0 builder: west twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T lichen/tests/rpl_routing => 1/1 configurations passed 100% (20/20 cases, artifacts /mnt/lichen-zephyr/work/twister-daoauth-fix6); python/tests/test_vectors.py -k route_state passes; both --check gates and validate_rpl_route_state.py pass. No assertion weakened; the delegation gate is now exercised by the suite.
